paragraphs: Chapter 649
Episode 165. After the Shock (3)
A small sailboat was heading towards Tikan. Behind the boat, white foam bubbled up as over fifty fleets that had been submerged sprung up to the sea surface.
It was a scene that he had seen once before, just before departing to the Sota Desert.
'Mary Sister...!'
Perhaps Cosmos, who had become her subordinate, had come to notify Bibou.
Or maybe she had already been infected by Rosa's chaos and was here to attack Tikan.
Fortunately, as soon as Mary approached Tikan, she revealed herself on the deck, and Jin was able to greet her with a sigh of relief.
"Youngest!"
"Sister!"
Their boisterous voices spread over the endlessly blue sea.
All the knights of Runcandel, who were in the middle of purification treatment, also ran out to salute Mary.
When Mary came up to the mansion, she was filled with hostility instead of feelings of defeat, powerlessness, and sorrow.
Jin felt a pain in his heart seeing her like this.
Mary was also infected with chaos, but it was not severe.
Jin realized that it was the result of Mary resisting the chaos for so long.
"...As I thought, you were the one who attacked the Sword Garden some time ago. Zipfel and Kinzelo were just looking for an opportunity in line with your movements."
As Jin told her about what had happened, Mary nodded as if she knew it would be like this.
She had recognized Jin's accomplishments at a glance.
"First, we need to pay tribute to Uncle Jorden."
"I will guide you."
Mary offered a silent prayer for a while at Jorden's coffin.
She originally did not have a good relationship with Jorden, but they had formed a bond and camaraderie by raising a flag against Rosa together.
In particular, Mary paid respect for his ultimate sacrifice to save the remaining knights.

"Looking at this, one can never predict human actions. Rosa Runcandel, who seemed like she would never betray the family, became a monster of chaos, and Uncle, who had been struggling to swallow the family by any means, ended up becoming a guardian of the family. Uncle's body must be buried in the family tomb after the family is reclaimed."
"That goes without saying. But Sister, how have you been? And Brother Diphus..."
"Diphus Brother is trapped in the basement of the Sword Garden. The day you attacked the Sword Garden, the knights Rosa Runcandel released probably excluded Diphus Brother."
"Did you see it yourself, Sister? The moment when Brother Diphus was trapped."
Mary's pupils narrowed.
"No, I didn't see it directly, but I heard the story."
"Please tell me in detail."
"That day, after most of the rebels were suppressed, Diphus Brother and I continued to fight. We two had just gone too deep into the melee, all the way to the building where Rosa was waiting."
And then, the siblings directly battled Rosa.
More precisely, only Diphus took Rosa's sword directly. As soon as he received a strike, he recognized the chaos invading his body and excluded Mary from the fight.
It was a decision made after assessing that even just a few direct confrontations with Rosa's sword would mean the end.
"Rosa had become as powerful as father. Moreover, she infected chaos, so there was nothing we could do. We immediately planned to escape, but Brother soon lost consciousness due to Rosa's sword."
Mary's body shivered at the memory of that moment.
It was through Diphus's sacrifice that Mary was able to escape from Rosa.
The only reason Mary left Diphus and escaped was to not make his sacrifice in vain.

"I had an intense desire to die there too. But then I wouldn't be able to avenge Brother.... But getting out of the building was not the end. I managed to escape from the Sword Garden, but I was surrounded by a pursuit team before I could leave Kalon."
The pursuit team was composed of about a hundred knights infected with chaos, among them was the Black Sword Society.
At the time, Mary did not have the strength to deal with them. She had already suffered terrible injuries in the process of escaping from the Sword Garden.
"It was Lin Milkano. The president of the Law Society, Lin Milkano, seems to have become the new leader of the Black Sword Society in place of Uncle. And Lin Milkano let me go."
"If she just let you go...."
"Lin Milkano was also against Rosa. I don't know whether Rosa knows this or if Lin Milkano lied to me.... But at least, it's a fact that she spared me and let me go."
-'I'll give you a painkiller, Seventh Generation. Go. I'll report to Rosa that you slipped away.'
-'What are you scheming?'
-'Don't think that only you guys wanted to restore the Sword Garden.'
-'For someone saying that, you're also using the power of chaos.'
-'I also made a separate contract with the Prophet, like Rosa. The method is different. We don't agree with Rosa's decision.'
-'You made a contract? Damn, what's on your mind?'

-'Then what were you guys thinking when you attacked the Sword Garden? Did you think you could have a final battle with just that much power? You knew about Rosa and the Prophet's power. It was just a meaningless suicide!'
-'Ha. What happens to Brother Diphus and the knights now?'
-'They will all be locked in the underground prison. Fourth Generation.... Rosa has been coveting him for a long time. There's a high chance he'll become one of Rosa's people. By chaos.'
-'Damn, that filthy....'
"Go quickly. Find the head of the family, or bring the twelfth generation. I don't know how long I can hold on."
Mary explained the conversation she had with Lin that day.
Thanks to Lin, she was barely able to escape from Kalon and take refuge in the Cosmos Pirates.
However, her injuries and chaos deepened day by day, and she could only focus on recovery, unable to do anything else.
And as soon as her recovery was over, she sought out Tikan.
It was unimaginable how much hardship she had gone through.
"If you weren't in Tikan, I would have immediately left for the Black Sea, like Uncle Zed."
She, too, no longer believed that Chiron was alive. It's just that there were no other options left.
But Jin returned, and change had already begun.
When Jin stepped into the Sword Garden, all the forces joined forces to attack Runcandel.
Though Kinzelo and Zipfel were enemies, forming a temporary alliance with them was far better than relying on Chiron, whose life or death was uncertain.
Jin met Mary's eyes as he sorted his thoughts.
"First of all, it's highly likely that Lin Milkano's betrayal of Rosa is true. I didn't see Lin Milkano in this battle."
"Then there's a high chance she's already been purged. If she really was against Rosa like us, I doubt Rosa wouldn't have known by now."

"I think so too. Even if she wasn't purged, the president of the Law Society has already made a contract with the Prophet. Just that alone means she can't be a perfect ally. She will eventually fall into chaos."
Therefore, it was right to exclude their support in the upcoming final battle with Rosa.

"And as for Brother Diphus.... I can only hope that he is in a state that can be healed with the chaos purifier I have. As long as he doesn't undergo physical transformation or complete erosion, we can reverse it."
"Brother is a strong person."
Mary clenched her teeth and continued.
"No matter what Rosa does, Brother will never easily break."
"Yes, that's likely."
"What are you planning to do now?"

"First, I'll hold talks with the two major forces. We agreed to gather in Tikan tomorrow afternoon, so I need to exchange information with them. About the power Rosa's Runcandel holds, and why they are staying still. And we'll set a timeline to attack the Sword Garden."
"Zipfel and Kinzelo must have also taken a significant hit this time, so they won't be able to quickly launch a counterattack."
"It depends on how many hidden cards the two major forces pull out. Also, if the Sword Garden is still unable to move for some reason, it would be better to take time and prepare fully."
When he escaped from the Sword Garden, Jin had incidentally connected with Rapha Rosa through Ling Ling, and Kwal is currently studying him.
'If the brothers come out before the final battle with Rosa.'
Even if that's difficult, at least if such a coincidence allows for 'Union of Deities'.
It would be incredibly helpful in the final battle against Rosa.
To bring down the Sword Garden, Rosa must eventually be killed, but anyone other than Jin is eroded by chaos just by fighting her.
That meant that during the battle they could potentially turn into Rosa's kin.
Therefore, the battle with Rosa was almost entirely up to Jin, and Union of Deities was desperately needed.
'Also, the return of Murakan...'
Murakan.
He has been unable to show himself since the last Hyeonhyeon.
While Talaris was injured, Misha had to bear the full burden of Elena's seal, so the time he had to act on behalf of Misha inevitably increased.
The union of deities and the return of Murakan, and the Golden Fleet.
When Jin revealed his best cards, a faint smile formed at the corners of Mary's mouth.
"Sure enough, you've grown up. The youngest. I feel reassured having you."

"We must try our best to be ready to fight with all three prepared. We need to clearly understand why the Sword Garden is not moving to properly prepare. And I also feel reassured having you, elder sister. So, don't cry."
Mary was sobbing in Jin's arms.
She was finally letting out the guilt of leaving Diphus behind, the pain of not being able to protect the family, for the first time in six months. To her grown-up youngest brother.
"Our Runcandel has neither fallen nor perished. We can reclaim it together, sister. Our home."
"This will be the last time you'll see me in this weak state."
"You don't look weak at all. But if you're struggling, you can lean on me like this anytime. Aren't we a family?"
Suddenly, there was a presence behind the two. The Tona brothers were cautiously approaching.
Upon seeing Mary crying, the Tona brothers were startled and tried to turn back, but Jin quietly signaled them over.
Then, the Tona brothers also hugged Mary and cried, and Jin comforted them by patting their backs.
